messages:
jessica: FYI — Product plans to flip Alpenglow (new LLM) to public traffic tomorrow 2026-03-19 12:00 UTC. Benchmarking shows ~2.4x token/sec vs our current baseline for 8k context patterns, but tail latency is spikier on long convo flows.
omar: Do we have GPU-hour estimates if traffic mirrors current Heron mix? Rough calc: if identical qps, expect ~2.1x GPU-hours because batching efficiency improves, but peak token/s could double.
liam: Quick numbers from my run: 1M tokens/day -> current=120 GPU-hours, alpenglow ~260 GPU-hours. That's with default fp16 on A100s. (I'll attach full CSV later)
sophia: Region note: eu-west has only 24 dedicated A100s free in that slot weekend. If we get heron->alpenglow shift we'll hit capacity unless we pre-warm or divert.
jessica: Can SRE call out mitigation options? I want a plan by EOD: pre-warm, reserve burst, traffic shaping, or roll out staged weight.
infra-bot: Deploy-check: Canary pools auto-scale up to 3x baseline, but quota caps per-region apply. See /infra quotas.
omar: Quick list of mitigations I'm proposing:
- Canary rollout 5% -> 25% -> 50% over 48h
- Route long-convo traffic to alpenglow-lite (quantized q4_0) which reduces GPU-hours ~30%
- Pre-warm KV caches on dedicated pool 2h before flip
- Add temporary rate-limiter for >2k token requests
- Hold eu-west rollout until we confirm extra capacity
liam: Cost hit estimate with current commitments: incremental spot + on-demand ~ $14k/week at 100% traffic. If we spin reserved GPUs (1 month) upfront it's cheaper but procurement lead time sucks.
sophia: Also must watch GFX kernel warmup penalty on first N requests. Suggest synthetic warmup script:
```
for i in range(100): curl -X POST .../generate -d '{prompt: "warm"}'
```
jessica: Thx. Action items:
- liam: finalize GPU-hours delta and cost model by 17:00
- omar: write rollout traffic policy and traffic-shaper config by 15:00
- sophia: confirm eu-west slot availability and options for temporary burst by 16:00
- SRE: prepare alert playbook for 99th-p95 latency and token dropouts
infra-bot: Note: Opening incident channel #alpenglow-launch if any SLOs breach during rollout.
omar: Also considering a fallback route to older model with header x-fallback-allowed=true so SDK can downgrade gracefully.
liam: I'll post the CSV and graph in a follow-up message.
sophia: minor ask: remind product to stagger feature flags for heavy pipelines (embeddings + generation) — that's a large combined signal.
jessica: Good meeting. If we don't have capacity we'll delay GA by 24h. Keep updates here. :warning:
